timing.schedule: delay = frame / 30 s from the action start
timing.fallback: a cue without frame data plays at action start (delay 0)
timing.dedup: identity = lower(file) | frame | unique, once per action instance
timing.volume: sounds[].volume, clamped to (0, 1] and scaled by the caller
timing.unique: sounds[].unique character token; empty is generic; accepted only when the archive uses that token for the voice dir

provenance.join_rule: opponent id -> config -> source_action -> set.sounds[action] entry whose file equals the base cue file

unvoiced.reason: archive action carries no voice for this character
